skills.name: ELF section surgery
skills.description: Read and patch section metadata safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.rabin2 sections to map the layout.
2. Compute patch offsets with re.ida.offset.
3. Apply byte edits via mem.write (runtime) or file tools (static).
4. Verify with re.hex.identify reads.

skills.name: Inline code patching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Decompile the target with re.ghidra.analyze.
2. Decide the patch (NOP sled, constant load, early return).
3. Assemble the exact bytes; document them.
4. Apply at runtime with mem.write; verify with mem.read.

skills.name: String cross-referencing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract strings with re.rabin2.
2. Pick the distinctive one; find its address.
3. re.ida.xref from the string address to code.
4. Analyze the referencing functions.

skills.name: Crypto routine spotting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Scan binaries for known constants (AES tables, SHA init) with python.run_file.
2. Map hits to functions via re.ida.xref.
3. Label the algorithm and mode.
4. Note key derivation call sites.

skills.name: License logic analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate validation entry points via string xrefs.
2. Decompile with re.ghidra.analyze; map the decision tree.
3. Identify stored state (prefs, files, registry-equivalents).
4. Document; modification only on owned software.

skills.name: Game object layout mapping
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Start from a known value address (mem.scan).
2. mem.read surrounding memory; identify adjacent fields.
3. Track the base pointer with mem.regions.
4. Document the layout diagram.

skills.name: C++ vtable walking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate the vtable pointer in an object (mem.read).
2. Read consecutive function pointers.
3. Correlate each with re.ghidra.analyze output.
4. Name methods by behavior.

skills.name: JNI string handling analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find JNI string functions in exports (re.rabin2).
2. Decompile usage sites with re.ghidra.analyze.
3. Note encodings (UTF-8 vs UTF-16).
4. Document conversion points for hooks.

skills.name: Smali method redirection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode; find the method with file.search.
2. Rewrite invoke targets to your helper class.
3. Add the helper smali class in the same patch.
4. re.apktool.build and re.apk.sign; install and verify.

skills.name: Asset secret scanning
skills.description: Find secrets hidden in app resources.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode to expose assets and res.
2. file.search for key-like patterns (AKIA, AIza, BEGIN PRIVATE).
3. Validate hits are live (not test fixtures).\n4. Report to the owner; never exploit.

skills.name: Manifest risk scoring
skills.description: Score attack surface from the manifest.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for components and permissions.
2. Count exported components without permission guards.
3. Note debuggable/backup flags.
4. Produce a risk table.

skills.name: Binary similarity check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.rabin2 exports of both.
2. Compare symbol sets with python.run_file (Jaccard).
3. Sample-compare functions with re.ghidra.analyze.
4. Report a similarity verdict with evidence.

skills.name: Patch safety checklist
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Backup the original (file.write copy).
2. Patch one thing at a time.
3. Verify after each step (build, sign, install, launch).
4. Keep a rollback path documented.

skills.name: Runtime call tracing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compute the function address (re.il2cpp.resolve / re.ghidra.analyze + base).
2. Plan a logging patch at the entry (mem.write).
3. Trigger the path in-app.
4. Read the log via logcat; revert the patch after.

skills.name: Native library diffing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.rabin2 symbols for both.
2. Align common symbols; list added/removed.
3. Decompile 3-5 changed functions with re.ghidra.analyze.
4. Summarize functional drift.

skills.name: Obfuscation technique map
skills.description: Catalog obfuscation layers in a target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note name obfuscation from smali (file.search class names).
2. Note string encryption via re.rabin2 strings.
3. Note control-flow flattening signs in decompiled code.
4. Rank layers by analysis cost.

skills.name: Stripped symbol recovery
skills.description: Rebuild meaningful names for stripped code.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Correlate JNI exports (re.rabin2) with Java declarations (file.search smali).
2. Name functions from their callers and strings.
3. Persist the map with file.write.
4. Incrementally refine during analysis.

skills.name: Anti-instrumentation survey
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search smali for Frida/Xposed strings.
2. re.ghidra.analyze for /proc/self/maps scanning patterns.
3. Map checks to their enforcement points.
4. Document; bypass only with user authorization.

skills.name: GOT/PLT hooking plan
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.rabin2 for relocations and PLT layout.
2. Compute the GOT entry address for the target import.
3. Plan the runtime write (mem.write) with correct pointer size.
4. Verify resolution after patching.

skills.name: Structure discovery by walking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Anchor on a known value; mem.read a window around it.
2. Tag probable fields by type patterns.
3. Validate by observing field changes during gameplay.
4. Record the layout with offsets.

skills.name: Static patch to signed APK
skills.description: Ship a patched APK end to end.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Apply smali/native edits per plan.
2. re.apktool.build.
3. re.apk.sign with debug key.
4. re.apk.install; verify the patched behavior on device.

skills.name: Symbol server awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note the module name/version from re.rabin2.
2. Advise fetching official symbols if available.
3. Explain the analysis speedup.
4. Fall back to recovery workflows otherwise.

skills.name: Strategy for hardened targets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. recon: re.apk.manifest, packer detection.
2. Choose the softest layer (resources, smali, or runtime memory).
3. Time-box attempts; report blockers honestly.
4. Never claim bypasses that did not happen.

skills.name: Ransomware behavior awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Watch for mass file renames/encryption in workspace ops.
2. Halt and alert immediately if observed.
3. Preserve evidence read-only.
4. Advise isolation and professional response.

skills.name: RE legal boundaries
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm ownership or research authorization.
2. Refuse DRM circumvention for piracy.
3. Prefer interop/security research framing.
4. State the boundary when declining.

skills.name: TLS stack fingerprinting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture a handshake (tcpdump.capture).
2. Compare cipher ordering to known stacks.
3. Note ClientHello extensions anomalies.
4. Fingerprint the client library.

skills.name: DNS tunneling detection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture DNS with tcpdump.capture (port 53).
2. Look for long, high-entropy subdomains.
3. Measure query rates to single domains.
4. Report anomalies with samples.

skills.name: LAN ARP monitoring
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. tcpdump.capture with ARP filter on the LAN.
2. Note duplicate IP claims.
3. Flag potential spoofing.
4. Recommend static entries or switches security.

skills.name: Firewall rule probing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. net.portscan with slow timing on your own host.
2. Compare results from inside vs outside.
3. Infer rule structure.
4. Document open paths.

skills.name: Capture lifecycle management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. tcpdump.capture to file with rotation.
2. Keep captures small via filters.
3. Analyze offline; extract IOCs.
4. Delete captures with sensitive data after use.

skills.name: QoS behavior test
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate marked test flows with python.run_file sockets.
2. Measure latency under load (http.capture.repeat).
3. Compare classes.
4. Report shaping effectiveness.

skills.name: IPv6 reachability checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec ping6/curl -6 to test hosts.
2. Compare v4 vs v6 paths.
3. Note DNS AAAA behavior.
4. Summarize dual-stack health.

skills.name: MTU discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. ping with DF and increasing sizes (process.exec).
2. Find the fragmentation threshold.
3. Relate to observed stalls.
4. Recommend MSS clamps if needed.

skills.name: Before/after traffic diff
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture session A (http.capture).
2. Update the app; capture session B.
3. Diff endpoints and payloads (python.run_file).
4. Report API changes.

skills.name: WebSocket message replay
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture the session; extract frames.
2. Replay selected frames with a python.run_file client.
3. Observe server reactions.
4. Stay within authorization; stop on errors.

skills.name: Push notification diagnostics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check app notification settings (android.app_settings).
2. Capture registration traffic (http.capture).
3. Verify token issuance.
4. Report where the chain breaks.

skills.name: RecyclerView navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen to identify list items.
2. android_scroll in half-screen steps.
3. Detect item repeats to avoid double-processing.
4. Collect targets as found.

skills.name: Horizontal chip navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen the chip row.
2. android_swipe horizontally within it.
3. Verify the selected chip changed.
4. Proceed with the selected state.

skills.name: Chained dialogs
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen per dialog.
2. Choose the correct action each step (androidclickelement).
3. Verify progression.
4. Back out cleanly if the flow is wrong (androidpressback).

skills.name: Bottom sheet handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Trigger the sheet (androidclickelement).
2. androidreadscreen its options.
3. Select; verify dismissal.
4. Handle drag-to-dismiss via android_swipe when needed.

skills.name: In-app WebView handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen detects WebView content.
2. Use androidclickelement on rendered links.
3. For complex pages, web.browser may serve better; compare.
4. Return with androidpressback.

skills.name: PIN entry automation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the user wants the PIN entered now.
2. androidreadscreen the keypad layout.
3. androidclickelement digits in order; verify masked field.
4. Confirm submission once.

skills.name: Date picker operation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen the picker layout.
2. Navigate month/year with taps.
3. androidclickelement the day.
4. Verify the field shows the chosen date.

skills.name: Slider precision
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen the slider bounds.
2. Compute the target x from desired value.
3. android_swipe along the track.
4. Verify with the value label.

skills.name: Drag and drop
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen source and target.
2. androidlongpress to lift the item.
3. android_swipe slowly to the target.
4. Verify placement.

skills.name: Keyboard dismissal
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidpressback once to dismiss the keyboard.
2. androidreadscreen to confirm the form is intact.
3. Avoid double-back (exits screens).
4. Proceed with the next action.

skills.name: Account switching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open account/settings via androidclickelement.
2. androidreadscreen the account list.
3. Select the target account.
4. Verify the switched state before acting.

skills.name: Deep settings navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compose the path from known settings screens.
2. androidclickelement step by step; verify each level.
3. Use android.app_settings shortcut for app pages.
4. Report the final path taken.

skills.name: Home screen widgets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Long-press home (androidlongpress) to open options.
2. androidclickelement Widgets.
3. Place the widget (android_swipe to home).
4. Verify it renders.

skills.name: Wallpaper changes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Long-press home (androidlongpress).
2. androidclickelement Wallpapers.
3. Pick source and image; confirm.
4. Verify with android_screenshot.

skills.name: Root screen capture
skills.description: Capture screens via root when UI fails.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec screencap to a file.
2. Verify the file exists (file.list).
3. Analyze with vision tools.
4. Clean up temp images.

skills.name: Root log access
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec logcat with buffers/filters.
2. Cap output; grep to the interest area.
3. Correlate timestamps with actions.
4. Summarize findings.

skills.name: System property reads
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec getprop (or filtered).
2. Note build/security patch levels.
3. Flag developer/unsafe props.
4. Report a compact table.

skills.name: Mount inspection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec mount / df.
2. Note RO/RW states.
3. Flag unusual mounts.
4. Explain implications for file work.

skills.name: Battery optimization exemptions
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +package.
2. Verify with dumpsys readback.
3. Explain battery tradeoff.
4. Confirm background work now survives.

skills.name: SELinux mode awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec getenforce.
2. Never switch to permissive without user consent.
3. Explain what enforcing blocks (common with mem tools).
4. Suggest targeted alternatives first.

skills.name: Boot service review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec list init services or pm dump receivers.
2. Flag BOOT_COMPLETED receivers (file.search in decoded apps).
3. Report autonomy risks.
4. Recommend disabling via UI only.

skills.name: Network policy audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec dumpsys netpolicy.
2. Note restricted UIDs.
3. Relate to app connectivity complaints.
4. Recommend policy changes via settings.
